fact: The director general of taxes states SIGFIP has been operational since 2021 across public finance execution and State budget execution (Tchadinfos, 5 May 2026).
The director general of taxes states E-TAX has been operational since 2021 in the public finance circuit, alongside SIGFIP (Tchadinfos, 5 May 2026).
The director general of taxes states these systems are operational in State budget execution, notably for mandating civil servants' salaries (Tchadinfos, 5 May 2026).

The article describes SIGFIP as an integrated platform automating the whole budget cycle, engagement to payment, and says the 2026 budget runs the spending chain through it (published 2026-01-24; no event date given).
The article names e-tax as a tax platform with which SIGFIP interoperates, in the present tense (published 2026-01-24; no event date given).

The Ministry of Finance's deputy director general of budget said the SIGFiP, deployed since 2019, is a central tool for public financial administration and is being extended to deconcentrated and decentralised structures.
FurtherAfrica says the Rwanda Cooperation Initiative implemented the IFMIS in Chad, integrating ministries, banks, telecoms and the treasury, with over 1,400 users trained.
FurtherAfrica says Chad's IFMIS covers human resource management, payroll and accounting.
The Secretary of State for Finance and Budget officially launched the SIGFIP at Bardai, marking completion of its installation across the national territory.
The Ministry of Finance and Budget's circular of 10 January 2024 says the 2024 general state budget will be executed entirely in SIGFiP, for central and deconcentrated services alike.
